messages:
Renee (People Ops): Quick thread to coordinate the off-cycle recognition run next Thurs. We're doing up to 30 $200 spot awards that need to hit the next payroll window. Need final list + budget codes by Tue noon.
Carlos (Payroll): Copy that. Cutoff for next run is Wed 11am PT to guarantee inclusion. If we get after that, it slips to following cycle. Also need recipient country for non-US folks.
Maya (Finance): Please include a single consolidated CSV with header: recipient_name,recipient_email,org,team,amount_usd,budget_code,award_reason,recipient_country,manager_approver. I'll validate GL codes.
Renee (People Ops): Will do. We're pulling nominations from Airtable beta view "Ready for Payout". I'll export and run a quick dedupe.
Ivy (Eng): FYI Platform team approved 6 awards. I'll confirm final names by Monday.
Noah (Sales): Sales has 4 but two are international. How do we pay EU recipients?
Carlos (Payroll): For EU recipients we can issue local gift cards or add to payroll in EUR. Payroll needs country and preferred payout method; if vendor card, provide vendor_id.
Maya (Finance): Also: any single employee awards >$600 need tax flag. These are $200 so fine, but if someone gets multiples in the same quarter we may aggregate for reporting. Ops should watch frequency caps.
Renee (People Ops): We've built a check: if cumulative awards >$600 in 90 days, mark tax_flag yes and notify payroll.
ops-notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Off-cycle recognition export due Tue noon" in #people-ops.
Carlos (Payroll): One more ask: provide manager_approver email for audit trail. Slack approvals are fine but we need an email in the file for records.
Renee (People Ops): Noted. We'll have managers confirm via a one-click email approve link and capture approver_email in Airtable before export.
Maya (Finance): Can you also include a column for "public_shoutout" true/false so we can avoid posting when recipients opt out?
Renee (People Ops): Added.
Ivy (Eng): Small product ask: when you export, can you anonymize reason text in the payroll CSV (ops-only) versus public announcement? We shouldn't expose internal notes.
Carlos (Payroll): We'll only ingest the payroll CSV columns needed. Keep internal_notes out.
Renee (People Ops): Timeline recap: Mon EOD final names in Airtable, Tue noon consolidated CSV to finance+payroll, Wed 11am payroll cutoff, Thu payments processed. If anything slips, we'll queue for next cycle.
Noah (Sales): I'll push my team to confirm by Mon.
Maya (Finance): I'll validate GL mappings by Tue 4pm.
Renee (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll post the export template and Airtable view link here in 1 hour. Ping me if you want to spot-check the CSV.
